newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Amador Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Amador Q2 results.

text.p: Bank of Amador Wednesday reported a 16 percent increase in earnings for the second quarter of 1997.

Profits for the Quarter ended June 30, 1997, were $362,000, or $.27 per share, compared to the previous year's second quarter figures of $312,000, or $.23 per share. Earnings of $674,000, or $.51 per share for the first six months reflect a 10 percent increase over last year's figure of $613,000, or $.47 per share. Total assets increased one percent to $74.8 million while total loans rose 7.5 percent to $49.6 million.
